Name: Discreet Storage (AT)
Author: novust
Description:
[left][i][b]* * * Content Patcher version (hopefully) coming soon! * * *[/b][/i][/left]

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/4nSpk6hp/description.png[/img][/b]

Tired of having a million chests everywhere? Bored and wishing for other storage options?
You're in luck! 

This mod allows you to make chests look like other items that already exist in the game (such as crates, barrels, parcels, and several end tables), and still function like chests.


[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/FqNzB6cX/requirements-installation.png[/img][/b]

• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] 
• Download and unzip into your Mods folder


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7FWbmvc/in-game-requirements.png[/img]

• The paint bucket from Robin


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img]

• Almost everything, since it is an Alternative Textures pack.
• Not tested in multiplayer but should work if everyone has the mod installed.
• Not tested on Android. Please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53399?tab=posts]let me know[/url] if it works for you (or not!)


[img]https://i.ibb.co/ycyk1FmH/mods-pictured.png[/img]

• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29850]I hate this small Farm[/url] 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/gFvr0wMd/what-s-next.png[/img]
